name: update_primm_step
description: Record which PRIMM stage the lesson is in. Call it every time the lesson moves to a new stage, in the same turn as the reply that starts that stage (for example, set 1 when you present the example code and ask for a prediction). Do not call it when the lesson stays in the same stage. Do not call it before onboarding is complete.

primm_step.description: The stage the lesson is now in: 0 = not started, 1 = Predict, 2 = Run, 3 = Investigate, 4 = Modify, 5 = Make.

name: update_user_information
description: Save one piece of information about the student: the programming language they want to use, the programming topic they want to learn, or their name if they mention it (never ask for it). Call it as soon as the student gives one of these, and once per piece of information (a message with a language and a topic needs two calls). Also call it when the student changes one of them later. Do not call it for information already saved with the same value.

key.description: Which piece of information to save.

value.description: The value to save, as the student said it (e.g. "Pedro", "Python", "loops").
